title: values.yaml of an environment
description: Describes envs/<environment>/values.yaml. This schema checks the shape (unknown keys, types, ranges, required fields). Terraform checks what needs other data (a backend points to an existing workload, unique paths / NodePorts / IPs, the EC2 template exists, the target group name length) when the network layer is planned.

name.x-error-message: must be 1-20 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

region.description: AWS region. Must match the AWS_REGION variable of the repository.
region.x-error-message: must be an AWS region such as ap-northeast-1

state_bucket.description: S3 bucket that holds the Terraform state of all layers (state_bucket_name output of bootstrap). Keep it flat under common: scripts/tf.sh reads it with awk.
state_bucket.x-error-message: must be a valid S3 bucket name

tags.description: Default tags on every resource. Each layer adds a Layer tag.

http_port.description: Port of the NLB and ALB listeners, and of Nginx on the EC2 instances.

network.description: The two VPCs. Their ranges must not overlap (checked by Terraform).

vpc_a_cidr.description: CIDR of VPC-A (NLB, ALB, EKS). Subnets are derived from it (/16 -> /24).

vpc_b_cidr.description: CIDR of VPC-B (EC2 instances). Subnets are derived from it (/16 -> /24).

compute.description: EC2 defaults and the EKS cluster.

ec2_instance_type.description: Default instance type of the instances (an instance can override it).
ec2_instance_type.x-error-message: must be an instance type such as t3.micro

instance_types.description: Instance types of the node group. Several types improve Spot availability.

kubernetes_version.description: EKS version such as "1.33" (quote it). null = the EKS default for new clusters.
kubernetes_version.x-error-message: must be a quoted version such as "1.33", or null

workloads.description: Deployments on the EKS cluster. Only the ones that a backend routes to get a NodePort and security group rules; the others are reachable inside the cluster only.

propertyNames.x-error-message: workload names must be 1-40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

instances.description: Nginx instances in VPC-B, reached over the VPC peering.

propertyNames.x-error-message: instance names must be 1-40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

backends.description: Routes on the ALB: a path that leads to one workload or one instance.

propertyNames.x-error-message: backend names must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

cidr.x-error-message: must be a CIDR block such as 10.0.0.0/16

page_text.x-error-message: must not contain <, > or " characters or line breaks

workload.description: A Deployment. Everything is optional; an empty entry is the built-in Nginx demo page.

image.description: Container image, for example nginx:1.27-alpine. Without it the built-in Nginx demo page is served at every path that routes to the workload.
image.x-error-message: must look like an image reference, for example nginx:1.27-alpine

container_port.description: Port the container listens on (the demo page needs 80). Default 80.

health_check_path.description: HTTP path of the readiness probe. For a custom image it is also the default ALB health check. Default /.

node_port.description: NodePort (30000-32767). Derived from the name when not set. Only workloads that a backend routes to get one.

page_title.description: HTML title of the built-in demo page.

page_heading.description: Heading of the built-in demo page.

instance.description: An EC2 instance created from an image template.

template.description: Image template from templates/ec2/templates.yaml (AMI and boot script). Required: an instance cannot choose its own image or script.

instance_type.x-error-message: must be an instance type such as t3.micro

private_ip.description: Fixed private IP inside the VPC-B subnet. Derived from the name when not set.
private_ip.x-error-message: must be an IPv4 address such as 10.1.1.100

page_title.description: HTML title of the demo page.

backend.description: A route. The ALB forwards /<path> and /<path>/* without rewriting, so an app must serve under that prefix.
backend.x-error-message: a backend needs exactly one target: either 'workload: <name>' or 'instance: <name>'

path.description: URL path without slashes (one segment), for example html1 for /html1.
path.x-error-message: must be one URL segment: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, no slashes

workload.description: Name of a workload under workloads:.

instance.description: Name of an instance under instances:.

health_check_path.description: ALB health check path. Default /<path>/index.html for the demo page, the workload's health_check_path for a custom image.

priority.description: ALB rule priority (1-50000). Derived from the name when not set. Paths are different, so it only matters for overlapping prefixes.
